title: Small steps: Consequence that restores
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Own impact, keep reasonable limits and create a concrete path back into relationship and learning.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
practice: connect the consequence to restoration and a return path
principle: Use consequences that teach, repair and make re-entry possible.
nextSentence: Responsibility and safety still matter. First, connect the consequence to restoration and a return path.
keyLearning: Use consequences that teach, repair and make re-entry possible.
